This is the video for module three: content, social media, email and WhatsApp.
Content marketing means attracting customers by being useful, not only by shouting buy now. Pillars stop you staring at your phone wondering what to post.
Teach. A salon posts how to protect braids at night.

say: Choose one or two platforms where your customers are, and switch to a business account to unlock free insights.
Amaka's photo of a platter reached 2,000 people and got 80 likes, comments, shares and saves. Engagement rate is engagements divided by reach, times 100. That is 4%.

panel.heading: Amaka compares two posts

say: Her short video packing an order reached fewer people, 1,200, but got 120 engagements. That is 10%, and it brought three times the enquiries.
So she makes more behind-the-scenes videos, and checks the pattern holds over several weeks.

panel.heading: Amaka compares two posts

say: Platforms can cut your reach overnight. An email list is yours. But build it only with consent, as data protection law expects.

panel.heading: Build an email list with permission
items: Ask clearly: what you send and how often
Use an email tool, not personal Gmail
Subject line that says what is inside
One useful item, one call to action
Judge by clicks and sales, not opens

say: Use an email marketing tool. It adds an unsubscribe link to every email.

say: WhatsApp is where many sales happen. WhatsApp Business adds a catalog, a greeting message, quick replies and labels. Tag each new chat.

say: Once a day, open Price sent. Follow up once, kindly. Then stop, because repeated chasing annoys people.

say: Mark a chat Paid only when the money shows in your bank app. Never from a screenshot alone.

say: Bisi sends her weekly menu to 180 customers who saved her number and agreed. 42 reply, and 31 order. When two reply STOP, she removes them at once.
Never add strangers to groups. Confirm every payment in your bank app, and turn on two-step verification.

panel.heading: WhatsApp rules for sellers
items: Message only people who agreed
Honour every STOP at once
Confirm payment in your bank app
Beware overpay-and-refund customers
Never share your six-digit code

say: To remember. Plan with your pillars, and turn one idea into many posts. Compare posts by engagement and enquiries.
Build email and WhatsApp lists only with permission. And a sale is paid only when your bank app says so.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Teach, Show, Prove and Sell cover the funnel
Repurpose one idea into many formats
Compare posts by engagement rate and enquiries
Email and WhatsApp lists need permission
Paid means paid in your bank app
